explainer_content.short_definition: Roots songwriting where country, folk, blues, and rock memory share the same porch.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Americana and country-folk grew around artists who used older roots materials without fitting neatly into commercial country or pure folk revival categories.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It preserved songwriter depth and roots continuity as country and rock radio became more segmented.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The center is the song and voice, with twang used as a storytelling texture rather than a commercial format marker.
